mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS id, m.metadata_field_id AS metadataFieldId, mf.field_name AS fieldName, mf.field_code AS fieldCode, m.app_field_name AS appFieldName, m.app_field_code AS appFieldCode, m.transform_type AS transformType, m.transform_value AS transformValue FROM tab_app_sync_field_mapping m LEFT JOIN tab_metadata_field mf ON mf.id = m.metadata_field_id WHERE m.app_ref_id = #{appRefId} AND m.sync_domain = #{syncDomain} ORDER BY m.id ASC
